comments.text:
US Navy needs more ships.  I my opinion we need to order another 45 Arleigh Burk Destroyers, 9 additional VTOL carriers, and a new Cruiser.  CGN. This would be about 175 meters long and 25-30 meter beam. THESE would use the same 2 Nuclear reactors used in Ford Class Carriers. Using these reactors saves money. And provides this Cruiser with massive speed and an extreme amount of electricity for weapons systems like lasers, sonic beam weapons, maybe even a Rail Gun.  The basic capabilities would mirror that of the Arleigh Burk Destroyers. The extra space and electrical power would be for Energy Weapons, Rail Guns, Drones, Anti-Drone weapons systems. Ideally we need about 30 of these and another 45 DDGs. with the majority of this new ships being deployed to the 7th Fleet. A CGN like this would be able to  project force and be able to defend itself. And when combined in mini fleets of 5 or more ships would control that area against anything that isn't a Carrier Battle Group. I do not believe in a need for Battleships.  We don’t need slow moving heavily armored ships to use main guns that might reach 20-50 miles.  Generally this is a very dangerous range for Capital Ships.  Consider the conflict with Iran.  We try to keep our naval ships far outside of that less than 100 mile range from Iran’s coast. 

20 year purchase order
45 DDGs * $4 B each  = $180 B
30 CGNs * $7 B each  = $210 B
9 LHA/VTOL * $5 B each = 45 B.  
Combined that is $435 B
Assuming front loading a bunch of costs to rebuild shipyards and train new trades people that is $30 B a year
Great investment in US shipbuilding, US Steel Industry, Trades people
